I'll compute the sum of numbers divisible by 3 in the given list using code.
```python
numbers = [-515, -48, 598, 566, 363, -102, -278, 628, 753, 584, -565, 757, 657, 205, 378, -393, -93, -234, 955, 653, -135, 988, -612, -327, -608, -159, -641, -428, 782, -380, 924, -867, -566, 545, 601, 946, -498, 503, 585, -445, -233, 355, -840, -202, -651, -533, 26, 162]

# Filter numbers divisible by 3
divisible_by_3 = [num for num in numbers if num % 3 == 0]

# Calculate the sum
sum_result = sum(divisible_by_3)

print(f"Numbers divisible by 3: {divisible_by_3}")
print(f"Sum: {sum_result}")
```
